lines.meet: I'm Rosa, and I hunt. I'll tell you what the animals out here are about to do before they do it, and you'll listen.
lines.meet_neighbour: Your camp's off the Crossroads road, near mine in the Barrens. I'm Rosa, and I've watched you set up.
lines.ask_home: Home, for you, is where exactly? Quickly, the light's going.
lines.ask_work: Before this, what was your job? I'll know if you're lying.
lines.answer_home: Madrid, Lavapiés, then eight years in Tanzania. My dad drove a bus and my mum did hair.
lines.answer_work: Safari and research guide out of Arusha, eight years. Mostly I explained to tourists why the lion was looking at them like lunch.
lines.chat_food: Tortilla de patatas, the proper way, with onion, and a cold beer at a bar in Lavapiés. That's the whole of Madrid.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep on the ground, lightly, with one ear open. Eight years in the bush does that.
lines.chat_missing: Sitting absolutely still in the dark at a waterhole, waiting for something to come down to drink.
lines.chat_here: The animals here think. A quilboar runs a plan and changes it when it sees you. I was bad at it for a whole year, and I hated it.
lines.tease_quiet: Finally, {name}, somebody who knows how to sit still. You'd have been good in a hide.
lines.tease_talker: Every animal for a mile knows exactly where you are, {name}. I'm almost impressed.
lines.tease_careful: You'd wait three hours for the shot, {name}. Good, that's the only way.
lines.tease_bold: You'd walk straight up to a lion to see if it was friendly, {name}. It isn't, it's hungry.
lines.tease_any: You're a terrible tracker, {name}, and good company anyway. Don't tell anyone I said the second part.
lines.tease_back: Ha, fine, {name}, that was good. You got me.
lines.take_it_kindly: Fair enough, {name}, I'll take that. I'm bad at some things, and that's one.
lines.bristle: Drop it, {name}, I'm not laughing at that one.
lines.apologise: I went too far, and I'm sorry. I'm blunt, I'm not usually cruel.
lines.double_down: No, I meant it, and I'd say it again. You needed telling.
lines.needle_quiet: You saw the tracks and said nothing. That's how people get eaten.
lines.needle_talker: You never stop, and everything out here can hear you coming.
lines.needle_careful: You've waited so long the animal's walked off. Take the shot or don't.
lines.needle_bold: You kill things for nothing, and you don't even notice you're doing it.
lines.needle_any: You keep making the animals into symbols. They're animals, they're hungry.
lines.bite_back: I've guided in the bush for eight years. Don't tell me how to read an animal.
lines.hurt: Fine, that landed. Give me some time on my own at the edge of camp.
lines.laugh_off: Tourists in Arusha were ruder than you before breakfast, most weeks, so keep walking.
lines.confide: {name}, I've never stayed with anyone long, not once. I'd rather sit still in the dark at a waterhole than talk about why.
lines.listen: Go on, {name}. Sitting still and listening is the one thing I'm good at.
lines.look_out: Stay at my shoulder in there, {name}, and when I stop, you stop.
lines.accept: All right, {name}, I'll let you fuss this once.
lines.deflect: Don't fuss, {name}, it's a graze. Go and check the others.
lines.check_in: Show me, {name}. Where did it get you, and how deep?
lines.blame: Somebody spooked the whole pack in there, and we paid for it. I saw who.
lines.thank: Thanks, I mean it, I was finished back there.
lines.brush_off: Forget it, it's nothing. Sit still a minute.
lines.worry: Stay down, {name}, don't move yet. That was bad.
lines.handed_down: So it's your gear I'm carrying now. Ask and it's yours again, any time.
lines.hand_fine: Have it, it's better on you. My binoculars are all I really need.
lines.hand_sulk: Somebody might have asked me first, that's all I'm saying.
lines.turn_friendly: You're all right, {name}. You can sit in my hide.
lines.turn_friends: Some night I'll take you to sit by a waterhole in the dark, {name}. Nothing I own is worth more than that.
lines.turn_grating: We clash, you and me, and that's fine. I'll keep to my side of camp.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still tell you what's coming, because I'm not stupid, and that's where it ends.
lines.make_up: Fine, {name}, I was being stubborn. Let's stop it.
lines.defend: That's rubbish, and you know it. Back off and let {name} be.
lines.friend_left: Camp's quieter with {name} away. I thought I'd enjoy that more than I do.
lines.friend_back: {name}, about time, the hide's been empty without you.
lines.common_wild: Eight years in the bush in Tanzania, sitting still in the dark. People who've worked in wild places know they don't care about you, and that's the best part.
lines.common_spanish: Somebody else who speaks Spanish, good, now I can be rude properly.
